{{Quote|I sent a team to look for it years ago&mdash;Project Pandemonium. The trail ran ended on Sarrassia, outside my realm.|Odion, on the Helm of Ieldis|<ref name="Knight Errant: Escape 1">[[Knight Errant: Escape 1|''Knight Errant: Escape'' 1]]</ref>}}
'''Project Pandemonium''' was an operation that was launched by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Odion]] during the [[New Sith Wars]], to discover the location of the [[Helm of Ieldis]], an [[Sith artifact/Legends|artifact]] created by the ancient [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Ieldis]]. The project came to a halt after Odion's operatives tracked the relic to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sarrassia/Legends|Sarrassia]], outside of [[Odionate|Odion's territories]]. However, in the aftermath of the [[Invasion of the Bactranate|collapse]] of [[Bactranate|the empire]] of Odion's rival [[Ayanos Bactra]] in [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]], Odion gained access to Sarrassia and he re-continued Project Pandemonium.
